def: Ira, the name of three Israelites

occurrences.text: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.
Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi–ezer the Antothite,
Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
